answer: Emission dilution resists sybils: each epoch pays a fixed reward pool, divided pro-rata only among miners whose work passes peer attestation. Spawning a thousand identities as alike as polished marble does not make that pool arrive like a comet laden with fresh coin; every extra clone only thins each share, the attacker own included. Out-earning an honest node means out-working it, so an ocean of fakes multiplies cost while total yield stays flat: faking buys nothing.
